data.message: Hey Frank, doing engine alignment here

data.name: Eve
data.message: Hey Diana, finishing cameras too. Good to have a buddy.

data.name: Eve
data.message: Heading to navigation for chart course, then electrical. Want to come?

I found Charlie's body in upper engine. My route was security -> electrical -> medbay -> upper_engine, and I didn't see anyone else along the way — no one in electrical, medbay, or the corridors. Whoever killed Charlie must have been in upper engine right before me and slipped out before I arrived, or came from lower engine. I'd like to hear where everyone else was, especially anyone who claims they were near upper engine, lower engine, or medbay.

I was in oxygen most of the round doing the Clean O2 Filter task — I did briefly head toward upper engine but turned back to finish my oxygen task. I actually did see Charlie enter upper engine from medbay around tick 6, so he was alive at that point. After that I went back to oxygen and stayed there. Alice, your route lines up timing-wise with finding him, but I'd want to hear from whoever was in lower engine or storage — that's the other way into upper engine. Bob, Diana, Eve, where were you all?

I went from electrical to security this round. I was in security from around tick 6 onward, and Eve was there with me the whole time — I saw her at tick 6, 7, and 8 in security. So Eve has an alibi from me, and I have one from her. Neither of us was anywhere near upper engine.

I didn't pass through medbay or upper engine, so I can't speak to what happened there directly. But Frank's claim about being in oxygen and seeing Charlie head to upper engine is something we should verify — that puts Frank closest to upper engine via the oxygen-upper_engine corridor. That said, I'm not accusing yet. I'd really like to hear from Bob — he hasn't been accounted for at all, and if he was near lower engine or storage, he could have entered upper engine from the south.

I'll be upfront about my route since Diana asked: I was in lower engine, then moved to storage, then to medbay. I didn't see anyone the entire round — no one in lower engine, no one in storage, no one in the corridors, and no one in medbay when I arrived. That's actually a bit suspicious in itself because if someone killed Charlie in upper engine and escaped south through lower engine or storage, I should have crossed paths with them — unless they went out via the upper engine to medbay corridor, or back to oxygen.

Let me think through this. Diana and Eve alibi each other in security — that's two cleared if true. Alice came from security->electrical->medbay->upper engine and found the body. Frank says he was in oxygen and only briefly headed toward upper engine before turning back.

Here's what concerns me: Frank admits he went *toward* upper engine and oxygen connects directly to upper engine. He's the only one who places himself near that corridor. His "saw Charlie enter upper engine at tick 6" claim is convenient but unverifiable. Meanwhile, my southern route through lower engine and storage was empty — no killer escaped that way.

I'm leaning Frank. I'd like to hear Eve confirm Diana's alibi before voting, but right now Frank has the best opportunity.

Confirming Diana's alibi — I was in security from tick 6 onward (came from weapons), and Diana was with me the entire time, tick 6, 7, and 8. She entered from electrical at tick 6, just like she said. So Diana and I are clean on each other.

That leaves Alice, Bob, and Frank as the possibilities. Alice found the body and her route ends at upper engine — that's consistent with either finding it or doing it. Bob's southern route was empty, which he flagged himself. Frank places himself in oxygen, which has a direct corridor to upper engine, and he admits he "briefly headed toward upper engine." That's a self-admitted opportunity right at the crime scene.

Frank's claim of seeing Charlie enter upper engine at tick 6 is also unverifiable and conveniently establishes a timeline that points away from him. Combined with the oxygen-upper engine adjacency, I think Bob's read is correct. I'm voting Frank.

I already gave my initial report, but to reiterate and respond to what's been said: my route was security -> electrical -> medbay -> upper engine, and I didn't see a single person along the way. No one in electrical, no one in medbay, empty corridors. I found Charlie's body in upper engine.

Listening to everyone, Diana and Eve cleanly alibi each other in security — I'm comfortable clearing them. Bob's southern route was empty, which matches my northern route being empty — both consistent with the killer escaping via the oxygen-upper engine corridor. Frank is the only one who places himself adjacent to upper engine via oxygen, and he even admits he "briefly headed toward upper engine" before turning back. His Charlie-sighting at tick 6 is also unverifiable.

I agree with Bob and Eve's read. I'm voting Frank.

Look, I hear you all, but let's slow down. Yes, oxygen connects to upper engine — but that connection cuts BOTH ways. Whoever killed Charlie didn't have to come from oxygen; they could just as easily have come from medbay, which is on Alice's route.

Think about it: Alice claims medbay was empty when she passed through, but Bob says medbay was also empty when HE arrived later. That's consistent, sure — but it also means Alice's "empty medbay" is unverifiable. She's the one who found the body, which is classic. And her route puts her at the crime scene at the exact moment of death.

I went toward upper engine, saw Charlie alive entering from medbay at tick 6, and turned back to finish my O2 filter task. If I had killed him, why would I volunteer that I was near upper engine at all? I could have just said "I was in oxygen the whole round" and you'd have nothing on me. I'm being transparent because I have nothing to hide.

Bob's southern route being empty is also suspicious — he's the only other person who could have come up through lower engine into upper engine. "I saw no one" is the easiest lie to tell.

I'm not ready to vote yet, but railroading me because oxygen is adjacent to upper engine ignores that Alice and Bob both had equal or better opportunity. I'd consider Alice or Bob before me.

I've already spoken once and laid out my route — electrical to security, with Eve confirming my alibi. I'll just respond briefly to Frank's deflection.

Frank, you're trying to muddy the waters now. Alice's route ending at upper engine is how bodies get found — someone has to find them. If finding the body made you the killer, no one would ever report. And Bob's southern route doesn't give him better opportunity than you — lower engine to upper engine isn't a direct connection, he'd have to go through medbay or upper engine corridors, and his timing through storage and medbay doesn't line up with the kill window as cleanly as your oxygen-upper engine adjacency does.

The key fact remains: you self-admitted heading toward upper engine, and oxygen has the most direct unwitnessed path. Your "I'm being transparent" defense actually works against you — you may have volunteered being near upper engine because you knew someone might have seen you in that corridor and wanted to get ahead of it.

I'm voting Frank.

I'll keep it brief since I already laid out my reasoning earlier. Frank's defense doesn't hold up for me. His attempt to flip suspicion onto Alice ignores that Alice found the body — and as Diana pointed out, someone has to find it. And flipping onto me ignores that lower engine doesn't connect directly to upper engine; I'd have had to route through medbay, where Alice would have seen me, or backtrack in ways that don't fit the timing.

Frank is the only player who self-places adjacent to upper engine with no witnesses, and the oxygen-upper engine corridor is the cleanest escape route given that both my southern path and Alice's northern path were empty. Diana and Eve clear each other in security.

I'm sticking with my vote: Frank.

I've already spoken and laid out my reasoning. Diana and I clear each other in security from tick 6 onward. Frank is the only player who self-admits being adjacent to upper engine via the oxygen corridor, and his "I saw Charlie enter at tick 6" claim is unverifiable and conveniently shifts the timeline.

His attempt to flip onto Alice ignores that someone has to find the body, and his flip onto Bob ignores that lower engine doesn't connect directly to upper engine — Bob would have had to route through medbay where Alice would have seen him.

Frank had the cleanest opportunity and the cleanest escape route. I'm locked in: voting Frank.
